zones.name: Quartier nord — route de la caserne

scope_notes: Exploration prototype using the real map/door/passage/snapshot engine.
No new combat stats, loot, narrative quest or barracks interior.
Civilian and armoured adult corpses reuse accepted native artwork.
Small monster corpse artwork remains to draw and review.
Buildings are cutaway footprints; final facade identities require review.

randomization.decision: At new-game construction, from game seed and a dedicated stable per-floor salt.
randomization.policy: Different visits, saves and cache eviction never reroll a floor.
randomization.retained: Same materials and same furniture/decal inventories per floor.
randomization.persistent_selection: Selected variant is included in the zone ID stored by WorldState.
